signature_matches.name: execute syscall
signature_matches.description: anti-analysis : may be used to evade hooks or hinder analysis
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: execute syscall
    namespace: anti-analysis
    authors:
      - "@kulinacs"
      - "@mr-tz"
      - mehunhoff@google.com
      - still@teamt5.org
    description: may be used to evade hooks or hinder analysis
    scopes:
      static: basic block
      dynamic: unsupported  # requires mnemonic features
    references:
      - https://github.com/j00ru/windows-syscalls
      - https://codemachine.com/articles/system_call_instructions.html
      - https://www.felixcloutier.com/x86/sysenter
  features:
    - or:
      - and:
        - or:
          - os: linux
          - os: android
        - api: syscall # https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/syscall.2.html
      - and:
        - or:
          - mnemonic: sysenter
          - mnemonic: syscall
          - instruction:
            - mnemonic: int
            - operand[0].number: 0x2e
        - or:
          - mnemonic: ret
          - mnemonic: retn

signature_matches.name: create process on Linux

rule:
  meta:
    name: create process on Linux
    namespace: host-interaction/process/create
    authors:
      - joakim@intezer.com
      - mehunhoff@google.com
    scopes:
      static: basic block
      dynamic: call
    mbc:

    examples:
      - 7351f8a40c5450557b24622417fc478d:0x40236D

        - api: execle
        - api: execv
        - api: execvp
        - api: execvpe
        - api: posix_spawn
        - api: posix_spawnp
        - api: popen
        - api: fork

signature_matches.name: hash data using djb2
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: hash data using djb2
    namespace: data-manipulation/hashing/djb2
    authors:
      - awillia2@cisco.com
      - still@teamt5.org
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: unsupported  # requires mnemonic features
    mbc:
      - Data::Non-Cryptographic Hash::djb2 [C0030.006]
    references:
      - https://twitter.com/r3c0nst/status/1392405576131436546
      - http://www.cse.yorku.ca/~oz/hash.html
    examples:
      - 6be0ae5cb7c3155f70d608fc7670d2d9:0x41DD19
  features:
    - and:
      - instruction:
        - description: hash = 5381
        - mnemonic: mov
        - number: 5381
      - or:
        - instruction:
          - description: hash << 5
          - mnemonic: shl
          - number: 5
        - instruction:
          - description: hash * 33
          - or:
            - mnemonic: mul
            - mnemonic: imul
          - number: 33
